speech.heard: Armenia has 100% urban sanitation access. In Dr. Congo, only 21.8% of people have it. This counts people using improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households. Israel, Kuwait, and Chile are at 100%. They have universal access for all urban residents. India is at 87.4%. Nigeria is lower, at 59.1%. Dr. Congo sits at the bottom at 21.8 percent. Armenia has 4.6 times the access that Dr. Congo has. Does your neighborhood have access to a private, improved toilet?
